age.evidence: Animals (9-10 weeks at the start of each experiment)

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin... was dissolved in sterile 0.9% NaCl saline... to achieve a final dose of 5 mg/kg. All injections were administered intraperitoneally at a volume of 10 ml/kg.

handling.evidence: To habituate animals to being manipulated, mice were tube-handled for 2 min/day for 5 days before the start of every experiment.

day_night_flipped.evidence: All experimental work took place during the light phase of the cycle... Animals were maintained on a 12-h light-dark cycle (lights on at 7:00 a.m.)

enrichment_housing.evidence: housed in same-sex groups of 4, with corncob bedding, nesting material, environmental enrichments

assays.assay_description: 30-min recording in individual acrylic cages (40x25x18 cm) under low light (10 lux); HTRs manually counted in 1-min bins; locomotor distance measured with AnyMaze.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice... were then placed into individual acrylic cages

food_restriction.evidence: no food in HTR apparatus during 30-min recording

water_restriction.evidence: no water in HTR apparatus during 30-min recording

time_to_assay.evidence: mice received a single injection of either saline or psilocybin (5 mg/kg; i.p.) and were then placed into individual acrylic cages... for 30 min

sample_size.evidence: Male and female C57BL/6J mice (n = 10 / condition)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (5 mg/kg) significantly increased HTR frequency in both male and female mice, with a significantly greater effect in females, largely driven by stronger responses in the first 5 min of the trial. No significant effect on total distance travelled.
outcomes.statistics: drug F(1,36)=609, p<0.001; sex F(1,36)=24, p<0.001; drug x sex F(1,36)=6.3, p=0.017; drug x sex x time F(29,1044)=1.6, p=0.031; male psi vs sal t(36)=15.6, p<0.001; female psi vs sal t(36)=19.2, p<0.001; female vs male psi t(36)=5.28, p<0.001
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin significantly increased HTR frequency in both male [t(36) = 15.6, p < 0.001] and female [t(36) = 19.2, p < 0.001] animals... it induced a greater effect in females

B1_num_measures.evidence: Head-twitches... manually counted and binned into 1 min bins... locomotor activity during the trial was assessed by measuring total distance travelled

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Head-twitches... were manually counted and binned into 1 min bins... significant drug x sex x time interaction

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is defined as 'rapid paroxysmal side-to-side head rotations' - a drug-induced proxy, not a natural ethological behaviour

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR does not require learning or memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: AnyMaze used for distance tracking; HTR counted manually

E1_environment_type.evidence: individual acrylic cages (L x W x H: 40 × 25 × 18 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: individual acrylic cages with transparent acrylic sheets above

E3_bedding.evidence: no bedding mentioned for HTR cages

E4_nesting.evidence: no nesting material mentioned in testing cage

E5_enrichment.evidence: no enrichment objects in testing cage

E7_social_context.evidence: mice were placed into individual acrylic cages

E8_food_water.evidence: no food or water in HTR cage during recording

D3_recording_days.evidence: single recording session on one day

D5_followup.evidence: recording immediately after injection; acute only

assays.assay_description: 30-min trial in novel cages (40x25x18 cm) with 20 glass marbles arrayed over ~5 cm of flattened bedding, under low-light (10 lux); number of buried marbles counted at end.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were individually placed into novel cages

time_to_assay.evidence: Starting 24 h after treatment, mice were assessed in a battery of behavioral tests

sample_size.evidence: In the male cohort (n = 15-16/condition)... In the female cohort (n = 16/condition)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin under control conditions significantly reduced the number of buried marbles in both sexes (anxiolytic-like effect). Concurrent stress exposure abolished this effect in both males and females.
outcomes.statistics: Males: drug F(1,58)=11, p=0.002; stress F(1,58)=8.9, p=0.004; psi-ctrl vs sal-ctrl t(58)=3.5, p=0.004; psi-ctrl vs psi-stress t(58)=3.4, p=0.005. Females: drug F(1,60)=7.4, p=0.009; stress F(1,60)=12, p<0.001; drug x stress F(1,60)=5.7, p=0.02
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin administered under control conditions induced significant reductions in the number of buried marbles... with concomitant stress exposure abolishing this effect

B1_num_measures.evidence: the number of buried marbles was counted

B4_ethological.evidence: marble burying reflects natural digging/burrowing behaviour

B7_automated_classification.evidence: counted... by two experienced researchers blind to drug condition

B8_multivariate.evidence: no multivariate analysis (though z-score composites computed across tests)

E1_environment_type.evidence: novel cages (L x W x H: 40 × 25 × 18 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: novel cages with transparent acrylic sheet above; no shelter

E3_bedding.evidence: over ≈ 5 cm of flattened bedding material

E5_enrichment.evidence: marbles are test stimuli, not enrichment

E8_food_water.evidence: no food or water in apparatus

D3_recording_days.evidence: tested 24h post-drug on a single day

assays.assay_description: Following 24-h food deprivation, 10-min trial in brightly lit (100 lux) white acrylic open field (50x50x40 cm) with a food pellet in the centre; latency to feed measured. Home-cage feeding latency assessed afterwards as control.

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were allowed to freely explore the open field for 10 min

water_restriction.evidence: no water in open field arena

time_to_assay.evidence: Starting 24 h after treatment, mice were assessed

sample_size.evidence: Male cohort (n = 15-16/condition); Female cohort (n = 16/condition); one mouse removed from NSFT analysis

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin under control conditions significantly reduced latency to feed in both sexes (anxiolytic-like). In males, concurrent stress blocked this effect; in females, the psilocybin-induced reduction persisted despite stress.
outcomes.statistics: Males: drug F(1,57)=9.8, p=0.003; stress F(1,57)=15, p<0.001; psi-ctrl vs sal-ctrl t(57)=2.7, p=0.04; psi-stress vs psi-ctrl t(57)=3.2, p=0.011. Females: drug F(1,60)=16, p<0.001; stress F(1,60)=4.7, p=0.035; psi-ctrl vs sal-ctrl t(60)=2.6, p=0.045
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin administered in control conditions induced a significant reduction in the latency to feed... the anxiolytic-like action of psilocybin administered under control conditions was abrogated by concurrent stress exposure [in males]

B1_num_measures.evidence: latency to feed for the first time being considered an index of anxiety-like behavior (home-cage latency is a control, not a primary measure)

B4_ethological.evidence: latency to feed measures anxiety-conflict in a novel arena (innate avoidance), scored as a single latency rather than as feeding behaviour proper

B5_social.evidence: mice were placed in the corner of a... open field

E1_environment_type.evidence: white acrylic open field (L x W x H: 50 × 50 × 40 cm)

E3_bedding.evidence: no bedding mentioned in the open field

E5_enrichment.evidence: food pellet is test stimulus, not enrichment

E7_social_context.evidence: mice were placed in the corner of a brightly lit... open field

E8_food_water.evidence: with a single pellet of food being present in the center

assays.assay_description: After 3-h single-housing habituation, mice received two sprays of 10% sucrose solution on the dorsal region and were recorded for 5 min under red light; latency to initiate grooming and total grooming time were measured.

setup_habituation.evidence: after being allowed to habituate to single housing for 3 h

setup_restrain.evidence: each mouse received two sprays... and was then recorded for 5 min

food_restriction.evidence: no food in splash test cage during recording

water_restriction.evidence: no water in splash test cage during recording

time_to_assay.evidence: Starting 24 h after treatment, mice were assessed... in the splash tests

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin had no significant effect on grooming latency or total grooming time in either sex. Stress exposure increased latency to groom (both sexes) and reduced total grooming time (males), independent of drug treatment.
outcomes.statistics: Males latency: stress F(1,58)=5.2, p=0.026; drug F(1,58)=0.0047, p=0.945. Males grooming time: stress F(1,58)=8.5, p=0.005; drug F(1,58)=1.1, p=0.305. Females latency: stress F(1,60)=4.3, p=0.042. Females grooming time: no significant effects
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin had no effect on either parameter [latency to groom or total grooming time]

B1_num_measures.evidence: The time taken to initiate grooming, as well as the total time spent grooming during the trial were taken

B4_ethological.evidence: grooming is a natural ethological behaviour

B7_automated_classification.evidence: scored offline by 1-2 trained experimenters using Solomon Coder

E1_environment_type.evidence: individual cages with transparent acrylic sheets above

E2_shelter.evidence: no enclosed refuge in test cage

E3_bedding.evidence: no bedding mentioned for splash test cage

E8_food_water.evidence: sucrose applied to fur, no accessible food/water

judge_notes: Four distinct behavioural assays identified: HTR, MBT, NSFT, ST. All three candidates agreed on this set; plasma corticosterone measurement was correctly excluded as a non-behavioural physiological endpoint.
B1 for HTR scored 1 (2-3 measures: HTR count + locomotor distance), matching qwen and gptoss; glm's score of 2 was incorrect (2-3 measures = 1 point, not 2).
B4 for MBT scored 1 (ethological - digging/burying reflects natural behaviour), matching glm and gptoss; qwen incorrectly scored 0.

B4 for NSFT scored 0 - latency to feed in a novel arena is an anxiety-conflict measure, not direct ethological feeding behaviour scored as such (per rubric: 'zone preference time is a spatial measure, not an ethological behaviour').
D5 for HTR scored 0 - recording occurred immediately after injection (acute, not >=24h post-dose).

Sex-dependent flag for MBT set to 'no' because psilocybin reduced burying in both sexes under control conditions and was blocked by stress in both sexes (no clear sex-dependent difference in primary drug effect).
Time_to_assay for post-acute tests (MBT, NSFT, ST) set to early_2to24h with value_minutes=1440 (24h post-dose, the start of testing window).
